fusions.name: Lap After Lap
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 5 tiles away as you pass. It deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Perfected Line
fusions.desc: Carries you through a turn that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Second Nature
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Miles of Practice
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
